expected_outcome: Do not make the change (source status: CLOSED_NO_CUT_IDENTIFIED). The spell can cost less as creatures die, then discards the hand, draws eight and deals eight to each opponent before exiling itself. The existing wheels, Mind's Desire and burn engines already cover substantial refill/closing roles. No cut is justified; close candidate, no list change.
